authorized_assumption: Already queued nodes trigger for prefetch; early disengage may overfetch; native execution remains unchanged

baseline_observations.observation: Pending is FIFO; new targets append after pending; self scalar state carries across activations, ability-local values reset; payload demand IDs deduplicate independently of queue execution.
Current certification declines recursive linear expansion for any nonempty pending queue. This is the boundary being extended, not a finding against an unreviewed patch.

Runtime builds fused SQL; native cache lookup compiles before cache check; publishing typed/native keys compiles twice per path. Compiler templates must cover selected cache publication/consumer paths if the no-runtime-build claim includes them.

Compile-time checkpoint serialization currently imports runtime dependency analysis and emits event graph only. New SQL template emission should keep compiler building separate from runtime selection/binding.

targeted_state_example.failure_to_guard_against: Binding both queued origins from identical initial scalar state incorrectly selects C->X; this is a targeted design regression, not a demonstrated new-source bug.
